s=current_frame.segmentation
def ppos(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<40:
            cc=[s['nodes'][c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
            if cc and cc[0]=='W':
                rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
                return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))

print('player now:', ppos(current_frame))

# list all N and c

    if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<60:
        cc=[s['nodes'][c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        print('N px',n['pixels'],'rows',min(rs),'-',max(rs),'cols',min(cs),'-',max(cs),'child',cc)

</function>
